title: Write src/greeting.txt
body:
## Goal
Create the file `src/greeting.txt` containing exactly one line: `hello from perpetua`. Create nothing else. Do not fix anything outside this file.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/greeting.txt` exists and its content is exactly `hello from perpetua` followed by a newline
- [ ] no other file is created or changed
## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(open('src/greeting.txt').read() != 'hello from perpetua\n')"`
## Context
- goal: `.session/loop-state.json` field `goal.text`
## Budget
- `src/greeting.txt` (new file)
